newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 17.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - April 17.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on April 17. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

Indonesian authorities have said they will not tolerate more rallies by supporters of Megawati Sukarnoputri, the ousted leader of the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI). Hundreds of Megawati supporters staged a protest outside parliament on Tuesday in a show of strength ahead of the May 29 general election.
No Indonesians have been found among the victims of Tuesday's fire that ravaged Mina city in Saudi Arabia and killed hundreds of Moslem pilgrims.
Foreign Minister Ali Alatas has sought to reassure foreign investors that the nation is politically stable and a good place to do business despite recent disturbances.

A number of investors plan to sue the Jakarta Stock Exchange for the losses they suffered after the exchange suspended trading of Bank Pikko, a small bank, late on Tuesday following a 207.69 percent rise in the stock due to local speculative buying.
PT Timor Putra Nasional, which produces the "national" car Timor, had offered the sedans to provincial governments because 5,000 units remain unsold.
